_note: Placeholder economy (docs/plans/day-structure.md, docs/plans/new-day.md). Tune with tools/run_runner.gd. Weights are relative.
_price_note: Item prices at tier C by rarity; each tier above multiplies by tier_price_bp. Legendaries are never sold (the price is for completeness).
_reward_note: The reward pick after a win: one enemy drop plus reward_pool_items items by these odds (the hard odds after the harder of the day's fights). Legendary must be 0.
_rarity_note: rarity_weights: shops and Loot. Legendary must be 0: Legendary items come only from the Vault and rare events (docs/plans/legendary-items.md).
_node_note: Each day has stops_per_day stop visits; each offers node_choices different nodes, one of them a shop, drawn by weight from data/nodes.json and data/events.json (docs/plans/new-day.md).
_legendary_note: Legendary relics are boss relics: only the boss's relic choice and the rare Ancient Reliquary event give them.
